question.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $B,$ given by

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $B$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $A$ has $3$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $3.$
